theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.27%) and Materials (+0.81%) led the market today, while Utilities (-4.11%) and Real Estate (-1.04%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.51%, defensives -1.54%, and value/cyclicals -0.09% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.49%, Dow -0.65%, Nasdaq -0.52% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.86%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 4.23% to 15.03, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.20% to $4,480.80, crude oil was little changed at $85.76, and bitcoin gained 1.67% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
